facts.text: Kill the black dragon near Brandonsford.
Eric the Reeve offers 1000 gold to whoever kills the dragon and drags its body into Brandonsford. George doubts Eric actually has 1000 gold.
facts.uncertain_reason: George says he doesn't think Eric has the 1000 gold to pay.

facts.text: The one-armed woodsman George encountered the dragon and describes it as a black dragon, not a big one. Eric says he lives a couple of houses down from the Clumsy Fox and might come to the tavern tonight.
facts.ended_how: used up: Sir Phidipaldi visited George and heard his account of the dragon

facts.text: Lady Hilda's offer to join the dragon hunt for pay could help the party fight the dragon.

A black dragon lurks near Brandonsford and may harm others. George says its jaws drip poison and one bite kills (he cut off his own arm), and it spits sulfur; it killed all his friends who went to its lair.
Farmer Gill's three sons are out hunting the dragon now, and Gill is sure they will bring it back. They may kill it and claim the Reeve's bounty before the party does.
Where is the dragon to be found outside Brandonsford?
facts.ended_how: answered: George says the lair is up north at the foot of the mountains (replaced by fact_new_1)

facts.text: Sir Brandon's dragon was killed and ripped apart centuries ago. Where did this new dragon come from?
George says the dragon's lair is up north at the foot of the mountains, with no climbing needed.
George says the dragon can't fly yet but will soon, and then they're all doomed.

George says nothing pierces the dragon's black scales; arrows and swords all failed. Father William says it can't be killed without the magic sword buried with Brandon, which is sought on its own thread.
Dunk says Warwick the smith's shimmering armor could help against the dragon and that he has a plan to get it.
